option_relations.rationale: Frontotemporal Dementia (FTD) is a broader category and does not specifically capture the ALS and TBK1 aspects present in the vignette and the provided leaf.
Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis–Frontotemporal Dementia (ALS-FTD) is a broader diagnostic category that encompasses the more specific 'ALS-FTD spectrum disorder (TBK1-related)' as a subtype.

Frontotemporal lobar degeneration–motor neuron disease (FTLD-MND) is a broader diagnostic category that encompasses the more specific 'ALS-FTD spectrum disorder (TBK1-related)' as a subtype, as ALS is a form of motor neuron disease and FTD is a form of frontotemporal lobar degeneration.

The option 'Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis-frontotemporal dementia (ALS-FTD) spectrum disorder (TBK1-related)' is clinically equivalent to the provided leaf 'Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis-frontotemporal dementia (ALS-FTD) spectrum disorder (TBK1-related)'.
